verdict.rationale: Hightouch's docs say it runs on top of your warehouse without copying data into a separate system. Data teams define models with SQL, dbt, or a visual builder over existing tables and views. Marketers build audiences from that warehouse data, and syncs activate it to 300+ destinations with CDC, optionally computed in-warehouse by the Lightning engine. Community threads add that Hightouch stores no data itself and that syncs are declarative SQL models mapped to destinations. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the warehouse-native activation flow, since the community corroboration comes largely from the company's own HN statements.
